title: Selva
desc: Selva becomes friends with Kamini, a minister's daughter. However, when she gets kidnapped by a terrorist group, he strives to rescue her.

title: Kanaa Kanden
desc: A young man comes up with a dream plan to help society, but he lacks the funds to complete the project. However, things take a turn when he meets a man who promises to finance his project.

title: Kozhi Koovuthu
desc: Velusamy, a jobless man, desires to marry his niece Kamatchi. He joins the army to earn a living so that he can marry her. Meanwhile, Kamatchi falls in love with Ramakrishnan, the village postman.

title: Bodinayakanur Ganesan
desc: Ganesan works for the local goon, Thiruvachi. His life takes a turn, when he falls in love with Raji. But, he has to clash with Thiruvachi who tries to marry Raji and send him to jail.

title: Diwan
desc: A cook falls in love with a wealthy man's daughter. However, after receiving her father's disparaging remarks, he embraces the challenge to amass a fortune within a year.
